name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.decodeNM_cost
typeText:
∀ {α : Type} {f : List.{0} Bool → DisequalityDispersion.Costed (Option.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} α (List.{0} Bool)))}
  {fp : List.{0} Bool → Option.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} α (List.{0} Bool))} {fc : List.{0} Bool → Nat},
  (∀ (l : List.{0} Bool), Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Costed.val (f l)) (fp l)) →
    (∀ (l : List.{0} Bool), Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Costed.cost (f l)) (fc l)) →
      ∀ (n : Nat) (l : List.{0} Bool),
        Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Costed.cost (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.decodeNM f n l))
          (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.decodeNC fp fc n l)

source.code:
theorem decodeNM_cost {f : List Bool → Costed (Option (α × List Bool))}
    {fp : List Bool → Option (α × List Bool)} {fc : List Bool → ℕ}
    (hf : ∀ l, (f l).val = fp l) (hfc : ∀ l, (f l).cost = fc l) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (l : List Bool), (decodeNM f n l).cost = decodeNC fp fc n l
  | 0, l => rfl
  | n + 1, l => by
      simp only [decodeNM, decodeNC, bind_cost, tick_cost]
      rw [bindPM_cost hf hfc (fun a l' =>
        bindPM_cost (decodeNM_val hf n) (decodeNM_cost hf hfc n) (gc := fun _ _ => 1)
          (fun as l'' => rfl) l')]

stepGoalPool.text:
α : Type
f : List Bool → Costed (Option (α × List Bool))
fp : List Bool → Option (α × List Bool)
fc : List Bool → ℕ
hf : ∀ (l : List Bool), (f l).val = fp l
hfc : ∀ (l : List Bool), (f l).cost = fc l
n : ℕ
l : List Bool
⊢ (decodeNM f (n + 1) l).cost = decodeNC fp fc (n + 1) l

α : Type
f : List Bool → Costed (Option (α × List Bool))
fp : List Bool → Option (α × List Bool)
fc : List Bool → ℕ
hf : ∀ (l : List Bool), (f l).val = fp l
hfc : ∀ (l : List Bool), (f l).cost = fc l
n : ℕ
l : List Bool
⊢ 1 + natC (n + 1) +
      (bindPM f
          (fun a =>
            bindPM (decodeNM f n) fun as rest => do
              tick 1
              Pure.pure (some (a :: as, rest)))
          l).cost =
    1 + natC (n + 1) + bindPC fp fc (fun x rest => bindPC (decodeN fp n) (decodeNC fp fc n) (fun x x_1 => 1) rest) l

α : Type
f : List Bool → Costed (Option (α × List Bool))
fp : List Bool → Option (α × List Bool)
fc : List Bool → ℕ
hf : ∀ (l : List Bool), (f l).val = fp l
hfc : ∀ (l : List Bool), (f l).cost = fc l
n : ℕ
l : List Bool
⊢ 1 + natC (n + 1) + bindPC fp fc (fun a => bindPC (decodeN fp n) (decodeNC fp fc n) fun x x_1 => 1) l =
    1 + natC (n + 1) + bindPC fp fc (fun x rest => bindPC (decodeN fp n) (decodeNC fp fc n) (fun x x_1 => 1) rest) l
